About Crogl | AI for Enterprise Security

Crogl is a security company founded by practitioners who spent careers at the world's most demanding security environments - national laboratories, global banks, and the companies that built the tools SOC teams depend on. They didn't set out to build another security product. They set out to solve the problem they'd spent years watching go unsolved.

Security analysts are among the most skilled professionals in any organization. They solve complex problems under pressure, with incomplete data and limited time. The problem has never been their capability. It's been the volume of work standing between their expertise and the threats that actually matter.
We exist to make security teams more effective. Every product decision, every feature, every interaction is measured against one question: does this help the people defending their organizations?
We build with the future in mind, adopting the best tools, architectures, and approaches available. We don't preserve legacy for comfort. We move forward because the threats do.
The name Crogl was built to reflect the three foundational principles that guide everything we build. The same three principles that define what it means to run a world-class security operation.
reasoning, rationale, process

Knowledge without reasoning produces data, not decisions. Crogl's agentic AI reasons across what it knows, follows your organization's workflows, and arrives at findings that a skilled analyst would recognize as their own.
Governance. Data. Process. These three concepts are not just our name, they are the architecture of every investigation Crogl performs.

Former security research leader at Splunk and Databricks. Spent time inside a Fortune 500 financial services institution as an end user to understand SOC pain firsthand. Founded Crogl to solve the problem he'd watched go unsolved for a decade.

Crogl has raised $30M from investors with deep roots in enterprise security and data infrastructure.
